scheme.name: Adicionamento sobre as emissões de CO2 (carbon tax on road diesel)

dataset.method: Código dos Impostos Especiais de Consumo art. 92.º-A: the adicionamento sobre as emissões de CO2 is 74.429 euro per tonne of CO2, from Portaria 203-A/2024/1 (published 2024-09-08, in force the next working day). It is charged with the ISP on gasóleo rodoviário, the product's CO2 factor times this rate, and passed on in the fuel price.

sources.title: Autoridade Tributária: Portaria 203 A 2024/1 (adicionamento sobre as emissões de CO2)

tax.note: carbon-cost states the tax basis in each table's text (dataset.method), not as a field.
